newsitem.title: USA: Queen Sand buys oil properties.
newsitem.headline: Queen Sand buys oil properties.

text.p: Queen Sand Resources Inc said Thursday it has acquired producing and developmental oil and gas properties located in five counties in east and west Texas from Janex Oil Co Inc and related parties.
The purchase price is $1,057,500 and 100,000 common shares, Queen Sand said.

It said the acquisition includes a 32.7 percent working interest in the Frymire Waterflood Unit in Nolan County, Texas. After unitization in 1992, a secondary waterflood program has increased production to 275 barrels per day -- 67 net to Queen Sand.
It said "the Harrison County property included in the acquisition includes a number of attractive Cotton Valley drilling locations with excellent potential."
